'''Z-Delta Squadron''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] fighter squadron used by the [[Zaarin coup forces|splinter government]] [[Zaarin's fleet|fleet]] of rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]. It fought at the [[Attack on ZA-13|First Battle of ZA-13]] during the [[Zaarin insurrection]], and at the [[Battle of To-phalion Base]], at which it took heavy casualties.
